::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6th [1878]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Eng. lett. d. 495 f108
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1444.qmd)

I desired the proof of the first chapter of the [Summer on the Apennines](organizations/other_904.qmd) to be sent at once to you - If you are moving about perhaps the best way would be for you to send a card with your address early every months to the printers 

[Messrs Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd)
Bread Street Hill
London EC

Will you have the [payment](organizations/other_102.qmd) every month or at the end of the half year, and how shall it be made

Yours truly
C M Yonge
